other_conditions: Unit must have its operations in Goa.
Unit must be a Proprietorship Firm, Private Limited Company, Public Limited Company, Registered Partnership Firm, or Limited Liability Partnership.
Bank accounts of the unit and its partners/directors must be linked to Aadhaar.
Bank accounts of the Freshers must be linked to Aadhaar.
Freshers must be recruited through campus placement from educational institutes in Goa.
Assistance becomes payable after the Fresher completes at least 6 months of continuous employment.
benefits_summary: Units receive ₹10,000 for each Fresher recruited through campus placement from institutes in Goa.
